figmaHints:
/* ================================================================
       DS Button Component — token-based styles from tokens.css
       Figma properties:
         color: var(--Color-Text-Bold) → --color-neutral-n900 (#091E42)
         font-size: 14px               → --font-size-sm
         font-family: Poppins          → --font-primary
         font-weight: 500              → --font-weight-medium
         line-height: 20px             → --text-body-small-medium-lh
         word-wrap: break-word
    ================================================================ */

transition.raw:
background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  transform 80ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  text-decoration 80ms ease !important
transition.resolved:
background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  transform 80ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  text-decoration 80ms ease !important

baseResolved.transition:
background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  transform 80ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94),
                  text-decoration 80ms ease !important
